newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israel responsible for shelling Lebanese village.
newsitem.headline: Israel responsible for shelling Lebanese village.

text.p: A five-nation ceasefire monitoring group said on Friday Israel was responsible for the shelling of a south Lebanese village last week which badly damaged the village and injured 13 civilians.
It said Israeli forces were responsible for the manner in which they carried out the shelling in response to mortar fire by guerrillas on its troops in a south Lebanon occupation zone.
The committee said in a statement it "deplored" the injuries caused to Lebanese civilians by the shelling of the village of Safad el-Battikh.

The group, comprising the United States, France, Syria, Israel and Lebanon, "urges that appropriate measures be taken by responsible authorities to ensure that such tragedies will not be repeated," it said.
All attacks on civilian areas are banned under a U.S.-brokered April 26 accord which ended a 17-day Israel blitz on Lebanon and set up the monitoring group.

The statement said Israel's representative expressed sorrow for the injuries and damage, calling them an unintended result of defensive counterfire after a Hizbollah (Party of God) attack. However, the Lebanese and Syrian delegates said the shelling was deliberate and was aimed at raising tension to prepare for a wider Israeli military action, the statement added.
